capabilities: Pointwise inference stages write their indexed words directly into the shared graph guard; dense stages retain their existing indexed guard path.
One whole-guard clear replaces P separate pointwise clears and P copies per forward. No per-stage pointwise guard buffers remain in the inference graph.
Direct, explicit and original-Module GPU forward routes share this Rust implementation; no Python or WASM arithmetic is reconstructed.
GPU tests inspect all stage words for masked dense/pointwise overflow at early/late stages, plus pending snapshots, valid recovery, indexed inherited errors and empty tensors.
The previous bounded owning output slots, bindings, queue submission schedule, parameter comparison and arithmetic policy remain in place.
boundaries: Reuse is ownership-gated, not a claim of global allocation-free execution. Per-call descriptors, CPU parameter checks, command encoders, an upstream guard copy, final guard pass and terminal readbacks remain.
The 32 MiB budget is retained output values/flags, not total physical GPU, binding, model or scratch memory. User-retained outputs can exceed it.

No value arithmetic, accumulation policy, one-submission schedule, error thresholds or automatic pure Tensor/autograd/ModuleTrainer routing changes. Shader guard addressing and pointwise metadata changed.
Browser A/B uses separate WASM/device instances in one page with rotated serial routes. Physical browser GPU and host exclusivity UNKNOWN; browser samples are visibly quantized.
The explicit scalar graph routes also change with this patch and are not unchanged controls. Only eager Torch is an unchanged implementation; all route ratios remain descriptive.
Native versions run serially in separate processes, each with eager Torch controls. Control drift is retained and cannot be entirely attributed to the code change.
Burst means eight independent fixed-input forwards plus final completed host observation, not recurrent decoding, peak GPU timestamps or fastest PyTorch.
No CUDA/Furnace, push, merge or release in this slice. Preliminary dirty-source logs are only preflight, not admitted timing evidence.

receipt.boundary: Three fixed replications; first standalone matrix remains included separately. No retries, filtering, exclusive-GPU claim or automatic tuning.
